title: Kavitha Textiles v. Mani Exports
text: The appellant, Kavitha Textiles, challenges the acquittal of the respondent-accused in a Section 138 NI Act complaint. The cheque of Rs 12,00,000 was dishonoured with the reason 'Funds Insufficient'. The trial court acquitted the accused on the ground that the demand notice was served beyond the statutory period. This High Court examined the speed-post acknowledgement and finds that the notice was dispatched within 30 days of the dishonour. Under the Negotiable Instruments Act, the date of dispatch by registered post is the relevant date. The complainant as drawer of the demand notice duly complied with the procedure. The court sets aside the acquittal. The drawer is held guilty of the offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. The matter is remitted to the trial court for sentencing after hearing the accused on quantum. The complainant is entitled to compensation equal to the cheque amount.
